title: Land & Real Estate Registration and Statistics

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Role and Significance of Land and Real Estate Registration
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the roles, significance, and system of land and real estate registration.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Components and Procedures of Land and Real Estate Registration
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the components of registration files and procedures for land and real estate registration.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Principles and Procedures of Land and Real Estate Registration
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Explain the principles and procedures of land and real estate registration.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analysis of Indicators in Land and Real Estate Statistics
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze indicators in land and real estate statistics and inspections.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Problem Analysis in Land and Real Estate Registration
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Relate issues during the process of land and real estate registration.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Components of Real Estate Registration System
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Identify components within the real estate registration system.

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Explain basic contents in land use rights certificates, house ownership, and other assets attached to land.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analysis of Initial and Change Registration Processes
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze initial and change registration processes for land and real estate.

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Conduct statistical and inspection activities for land and real estate.

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the system of indicators in land and real estate statistics.
Demonstrate ability to work individually and in groups when selecting and solving problems related to land and real estate registration.
Show initiative in learning, researching, and working in groups.
